# tomlc99

Vendored copy of [cktan/tomlc99](https://github.com/cktan/tomlc99), a
single-file C99 TOML parser (MIT license).

- Upstream commit: `29076dfd095bbbbd50a3c1b2760d29f4b83e74ac`
- Files: `toml.h`, `toml.c`

See the `LICENSE` header in each file for the MIT license text. This library
replaces libconfig for ROTBOSON parameter parsing (Phase 2 of `PLAN.md`).
